meta_title: opency · Your agency's content team, inside your agent
meta_description: Open source skill and MCP server that turn your agent into an art director, designer and copywriter. Set up a brand from its website in minutes, design carousels from what each slide has to say, and check every render at the pixel level. Runs locally.
hero_lead: opency is a skill and an MCP server that turn Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client into an art director, designer and copywriter. It runs on your machine; brands and pieces are files you own.
hero_note: No SaaS. No account. No download limits.
hero_scene_label: A five-slide carousel passing its quality checks
brief_lead: What you want to convey, goal, audience, offer, tone, channels and dates. It builds the brief from that; only then does it compose.
demo_user_request: I need a campaign for the winter blend launch.
demo_q_message: Before I design: what do you want to convey?
demo_q_audience: Who are we talking to, and on which channels?
demo_a_audience: People who brew coffee at home. Instagram and LinkedIn.
demo_q_facts: Which facts can I state? I don't make up figures or prices.
demo_a_facts: We roast on Mondays. Ships in 48 h.
demo_result: Done. A 6-slide 4:5 carousel, captions and alt text.
flow_title: From the brief to a file ready to publish.
flow_lead: Six steps, all inside your repository. The agent does the work; you decide what ships.
flow_1_body: The agent asks what you want to convey, goal, audience, offer, tone, channels and dates before touching a slide.
flow_2_body: Give it a name and a website: it proposes the palette, installs the typefaces, saves the logo and shows you a brand board to say yes or no to. No website? Start from one of eight presets. Set up in four short steps you can stop and resume.
flow_3_body: The agent says what each slide has to say and a compositor picks the layout, with the reason for every choice. Carousels, posts and stories in 4:5, 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9, with captions, alt text, PDF and MP4. Want another look? Same words, another structure.
flow_4_body: Your photos first; then stock from Openverse and Unsplash with credit and license recorded, focal point and protected regions.
flow_5_body: Measured on the render: contrast, safe zones, widows, crops that cut faces, unsourced figures and AI-sounding phrases. Safe fixes are applied automatically.
flow_6_body: A subagent reviews it cold. You get one page to forward to your client and a folder ready to upload. The agent never publishes on its own.
quality_title: It measures the render, not the intent.
quality_lead: Every piece is laid out by a real browser engine, rasterized at twice the size for clean type, and checked pixel by pixel. Passing checks is not aesthetic approval, which is why a cold review follows.
mcp_title: The same tools, in any client.
mcp_lead: The skill teaches the agent the craft; the MCP gives it hands. One call goes from what you want to say to a composed, rendered, checked carousel, and it remembers what you liked. It runs over stdio, with no server to maintain.
install_lead: Connect the MCP and add the skill. Then say "set up my brand": four short steps take you from a name to your first piece. Your brands live in ~/opency, created on first use. You need Node and Chrome.
install_skill_note: Adds the skill to your agent.
install_workspace_note: Renders a demo carousel on your machine. Nothing to set up.
install_mcp_note: In Claude Code. For other clients, paste this block into their configuration:
why_title: Built for agencies, not for a dashboard.
why_1_body: MIT license. Read the code, change it, send a PR.
why_2_body: Runs on your machine with your agent. No account, no third-party server.
why_3_body: HTML and CSS per slide, versionable in git. Nothing is locked in.
why_4_body: Layouts are chosen by explicit design criteria and checked on the rendered image, not on a promise.
why_5_body: One folder per brand, with its kit, voice and history, from day one.
cta_title: Your next campaign, in your repository.
cta_lead: Install it in a minute and ask for the first piece.
footer_tagline: Open source skill and MCP for content teams.
og_description: Open source skill and MCP server: interactive brief, on-brand campaigns and pixel-level quality control. Runs locally.

hero_lead_short: A skill and an MCP server that turn your agent into an art director, designer and copywriter. It runs on your machine.
setup_title: From a name to a first piece, in four steps.
setup_lead: No form to fill in. You talk; the agent asks two or three things at a time, saves each answer and can pick up where you left off.
setup_1_body: A name, and a website if you have one. That is all it needs to start.
setup_2_body: It reads your site or starts from a preset, repairs any color pair that fails contrast, installs the typefaces and shows you a brand board.
setup_3_body: What your content should achieve and who it is for. Choices and suggestions, not an essay.
setup_4_body: Three ideas that fit that goal. Pick one and it is designed, rendered and checked.
setup_user_1: Set up my brand: Kumo Café, kumocafe.com
setup_agent_1: Created Kumo Café. Reading the site now.
setup_agent_2: Done. Here is your board: does it look like the brand?
setup_board_alt: Brand board of Kumo Café: seven color swatches with their roles, the contrast of each text pair, the three typefaces and three sample slides.
setup_goal_audience: Who do you want to reach
setup_goal_note: The suggestions change with the objective you pick.
setup_piece_alt: The first piece of Kumo Café: a four-slide carousel in its brand colors.
setup_piece_status: 4 slides · 0 errors · ready for your approval
compose_title: You say what each slide has to say. It decides how it looks.
compose_lead: The agent sends the job of every slide, its claim and its proof. A compositor picks the layout from 23 recipes with explicit design criteria, and gives the reason for every choice. No model runs in that step and nothing is invented.
compose_reason_a1: Short claim, drawn for a cover
compose_reason_a2: Turns light after a dark slide
compose_reason_a3: A peak that contrasts with what comes before
compose_reason_a4: One action, in its own bar
compose_same_words: Same words. Another structure. The first one stays a restore away.
compose_slides_alt_a: The carousel as first composed: poster, numbered steps, a big number and a closing slide.
compose_slides_alt_b: The same carousel recomposed: darker poster, steps as cards, the number as a poster and a closing slide.
compose_fact_2: Never smaller type: copy that fits nowhere is reported
compose_fact_3: Learns what you liked and what you rejected
setup_board_caption: Palette, contrast, typefaces and three sample slides, in one image.
setup_pause_hint: Pauses while you hover. Pick any step to jump to it.
